title: Bounds for the median of the generalized hyperbolic and related distributions
summary: We prove monotonicity properties for medians of gamma sums and differences of the form $Z_α = αX_1 + (2 - α)X_2$, where $X_1$ and $X_2$ are independent gamma random variables with common shape parameter. By combining these monotonicity properties with known bounds for the median of the gamma distribution, we establish sharp bounds for the median of the variance-gamma and McKay Type I distributions.
